text:
Sam T: Dropping a quick read of the latest catalog compare wireframes. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC. TL;DR: main concerns = filter rail density, how compare rows collapse/expand, badge semantics for perf, and the pin UX when comparing multiple model versions.

Priya N: Love the direction. A few concrete asks: 1) keep primary filters (model family, quant) visible, tuck heuristics/advanced into a secondary drawer; 2) when you switch between grid/list the selected filters should persist without flicker; 3) badge copy should avoid ambiguous words like "fast".

Jordan C: From an engineering POV 1ms: virtualization + dynamic heights is the pain. Suggest we implement a density mode toggle (Comfortable/Compact) that changes CSS variables instead of re-rendering the DOM tree. Example var approach:
```
:root { --row-height: 64px; }
[data-density="compact"] { --row-height: 44px; }
.row { height: var(--row-height); }
```
This keeps virtualization happy and keyboard focus stable.

Maya K: Good call. For the compare header — can we have a collapsed compact state that still shows model avatars + pinned badge but moves controls into an overflow menu when scrolled? Keeps visual context.

Priya N: Badge semantics: research shows users conflate "performance" with RLHF/quality. Propose two separate badges: "Latency" (ms) and "Cost" (est $/1k). Keep an optional "throughput" metric for heavy batch use. Tooltips should show p50/p90 and sample token breakdown.

Sam T: Accessibility items: contrast for the green success badge is borderline at 12px; let's move to 700 weight or darker hex. Also make badges focusable with role="status" and an aria-label like "Latency: p90 210ms" so screen readers announce metric + qualifier.

Jordan C: About pinning: need to decide scope. Current proposal is "pin per comparison" vs "pin globally on the model card". My preference: pin at the comparison level (local) but surface a small toggle that says "Apply to all comparisons" for power users. Also add a small undo snackbar after pin.

Priya N: Microcopy: prefer "Lock this version in comparison" over "Pin". It's clearer. Also change the hover text on the pin icon from "Pin" -> "Lock version (undo available)".

build-bot: Canary feature flag created: catalog_compare_density_toggle_v1 in staging. Use `/ff catalog_compare_density_toggle_v1 on` to enable for yourself.

Maya K: Nice. Dev tasks: Jordan will ship CSS var density toggle + stable virtualization adjustments. Sam will do contrast/color pass and ARIA updates. Priya and I will iterate copy and tooltip content. Plan to ship behind flag and run a 2-week canary on 5 orgs.

Jordan C: I'll add the URL-encoded filter state helper too so users can share views: `?view=compare&filters=family:gpt,quant:8bit&density=compact`. That also helps e2e tests to seed state.

Sam T: Quick question on rollout telemetry 1ms: what metrics do we track? Suggest: time-to-first-compare (ms), pin usage rate, density toggle adoption, and mis-click rate on pin (undo rate).

Maya K: Agree. I'll add those to the agenda and set up dashboard cards in console. Sync tomorrow 11am to finalize copy and rollout targets. Thanks all! :sparkles:
